headline: News Corp. (NWSA) Stock Draws Fresh Price Target Split As Fair Value Edges Higher
summary: Price targets for News Corp. have been revised in both directions, with the updated model lifting fair value from US$35.18 to US$36.68, roughly a 4.3% change. Analysts are split, with some raising targets on stronger conviction in the story and others trimming expectations, which reflects a more debated view of risk and reward at current levels.
